meta.name: hooked-ux
meta.description: Design habit-forming product loops using the Hook Model (Trigger, Action, Variable Reward, Investment). Use when the user mentions "users arent coming back", "habit formation", "engagement loops", "habit zone", or "the manipulation matrix". Also trigger when designing notification or re-engagement strategies, building streaks or progress systems, or analyzing why users stop after signup. Covers ethics evaluation and onboarding for habits. For friction reduction and B=MAP, see improve-retention. For viral sharing, see contagious.

copy.tagline: 设计让用户上瘾的产品习惯回路
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户注册后不再回来，需要提升产品粘性
copy.tagline_en: Design habit-forming product loops to boost user retention
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users stop returning after signup and you need to increase engagement

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 Hook 模型（触发、行动、可变奖励、投入）帮你设计让用户上瘾的产品流程，并给出评分和改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“用户不回来”、“习惯养成”、“参与循环”等关键词，或要求设计通知、重新激活策略、连续签到系统，或分析用户注册后流失原因时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析为什么用户注册后就不回来了。
say.note: Claude 会用 Hook 模型诊断问题并给出评分。

say.text: 设计一个让用户每天打开 App 的通知策略。
say.note: Claude 会基于触发和奖励原理给出方案。

say.text: 评估这个签到功能的伦理风险。
say.note: Claude 会使用操纵矩阵检查是否属于剥削性设计。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude uses the Hook Model (Trigger, Action, Variable Reward, Investment) to help you design habit-forming product loops, scoring each loop and suggesting improvements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "users aren't coming back", "habit formation", "engagement loops", etc., or when designing notification/re-engagement strategies, streaks/progress systems, or analyzing post-signup drop-off.

say_en.text: Analyze why users stop after signup.
say_en.note: Claude diagnoses using the Hook Model and gives a score.

say_en.text: Design a daily notification strategy to bring users back.
say_en.note: Claude suggests based on trigger and reward principles.

say_en.text: Evaluate the ethics of this streak feature.
say_en.note: Claude uses the Manipulation Matrix to check for exploitative design.
